name: The Love Potion
label: Quest
description: The Love Potion: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, the pains of love! My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms. I am spurned! It's maddening!

You must help me! We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart. To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of Azshara, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro. You can place the water in this vial.
Please, friend, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the ingredients? The hole in my heart threatens to consume me!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you've done it! I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot. Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!
Thank you, friend. You are a champion of love!
